messages:
pagerduty-bot: HIGH Severity alert — 30% increase in 5xx on /v1/generate (dataplane) across us-east-1. Error spike started ~12:04 UTC. Affected shards: dp-7, dp-9. Bridge: https://zoom/abc123
alex: I see it, joining bridge. Pinging on-call infra. Starting live mitigation: temporarily route to standby dp-pool and enable model-fallback. Will post runbook steps.
maria: On it. console shows 'healthy' for control plane, but API clients seeing 503s. Can someone grab logs from dp-7? @jonathan any recent config pushes?
jonathan: I did a small rollout 11:58 UTC to change routing TTL flags (canary). No errors reported during deploy. I'm checking propagation now.
alex: Mitigation step 1: set routing_policy=allow-fallback on service-config. Command:
```
redwoodctl set service-config inference routing_policy=allow-fallback --env prod --region us-east-1
```

alex: Mitigation step 2: scale dp fallback pool +2 nodes (hot). Doing `kubectl scale` now.
ryan: Heads-up: support tickets inbound — customers reporting 'model not available' errors. Listing top 3 impacted: AcmeCorp, MidFi, Newsly. Ryan to open status page update.
sophie: Can we confirm if control-plane config acknowledges new flag but dataplane still returns old config? I saw mismatch earlier in similar incident.
maria: Pulled logs from dp-7:
```
2026-03-15T12:05:22Z ERROR request_id=abc123 timeout to backend kv-cache
2026-03-15T12:05:23Z WARN config_version=42 expected=43
2026-03-15T12:05:23Z ERROR trace=... 503 write to client
```
maria: control-plane accepts update:
```
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer ..." https://controlplane.internal/api/v1/config?service=inference
{"service":"inference","config_version":43,"routing_policy":"allow-fallback"}
```
maria: dataplane config endpoint returns v42 on dp-7:
```
curl -s http://dp-7.internal/config
{"service":"inference","config_version":42,"routing_policy":"strict"}
```
jonathan: That's the smoking gun — config propagation lag. Hypothesis 1: rollout agent failed to push to dp-7 due to temporary network egress failure during canary window.
jonathan: Hypothesis 2: feature-flag propagation was gated by new rollout controller that skips nodes with high CPU; dp-7 reported CPU 95% and was excluded.
alex: For live mitigation, forcing on-disk sync to dp-7 now:
```
redwoodctl sync-node dp-7 --service inference --version 43
```
infra-bot: Job started: sync-node dp-7 (job id 8f3a). Estimated 40s.
infra-bot: Job complete: sync-node dp-7 (8f3a) — result=success
maria: dp-7 now shows config_version=43 and routing_policy=allow-fallback. Logs show no more 503s for that host.
alex: Rolling back canary? No, we want config to be consistent. I'm keeping rollout active, will monitor latency and error rates.
jonathan: Adding note: rollout controller metrics show 4 nodes behind for ~3m window during the push. Need to check egress subnet ACLs.
ryan: Support update drafted: "We're actively mitigating an availability issue affecting generation endpoints in us-east-1. We have applied fallback routing and synchronized configs; errors are decreasing. We'll follow up with an RCA." Posting now.
sophie: Can we capture timeline bullets for RCA? I'll start a thread doc.
alex: Timeline (draft):
- 11:58 UTC: rollout initiated (routing TTL flag -> version 43)
- 12:04 UTC: dataplane error spike observed (503s) — pagerduty alert
- 12:05–12:08 UTC: initial investigation; control-plane reports v43, dp-7 reports v42
- 12:09 UTC: forced config sync to dp-7
- 12:10 UTC: dp-7 reports v43; errors fall back to baseline
- 12:20 UTC: fallback routing enabled and dp pool scaled; support notices sent

maria: Logs for RCA attached (S3): s3://redwood-incidents/1802500000/logs.tar.gz
alex: Owner for RCA write-up: jonathan + maria; I'll own mitigation timeline and customer impact section. Sophie will coordinate postmortem publish cadence.
jonathan: Root cause hypothesis to investigate deeper: rollout controller excludes high-utilization nodes leading to config drift; verify controller code path for CPU gating and network timeouts during push.
maria: Action items:
- Verify rollout controller exclusion criteria (jonathan)
- Add retry/backoff and alert on nodes left behind (eng-runtime)
- Add feature: control-plane to report propagation progress per node (observability)
- Update incident runbook to include forced sync steps (SRE)

alex: Handoff: I'm primary for next 30m, then maria will take over. Maria ack?
maria: taking over at 12:40 UTC. ack.
ryan: I'll compile impacted customer list + support threads and link to RCA when ready.
jonathan: I'll open a PR for rollout controller fix and link it here: https://git/repo/pull/456
sophie: Great. Once RCA draft ready, please add severity rationale and external communication text. :+1:
alex: closing bridge in 10m if metrics stay healthy. Good job team. :tada:
